name: 2,5-dimethoxy-4-(2-fluoroethyl)amphetamine
summary: 2,5-Dimethoxy-4-(2-fluoroethyl)amphetamine (DOEF) is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families.

pharmacology.en: Like other DOx drugs, it is thought to act mainly as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他DOx類藥物一樣，它被認為主要是血清素5-HT2A受體的促效劑。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他DOx类药物一样，它被认为主要是血清素5-HT2A受体的促效剂。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the DOx amphetamines such as DOM and DOB, are strong, long lasting psychedelics. They can cause anxiety, confusion, a faster heartbeat, raised blood pressure and body temperature, and strong ones can narrow blood vessels.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的DOx類安非他命（例如DOM與DOB）是強效且作用持久的迷幻藥，可能造成焦慮、意識混亂、心跳加快、血壓與體溫升高，強效者可能使血管收縮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的DOx类安非他命（例如DOM与DOB）是强效且作用持久的迷幻药，可能造成焦虑、意识混乱、心跳加快、血压与体温升高，强效者可能使血管收缩。

fact.en: It is a version of DOET in which a fluorine atom sits on the end of the ethyl chain.
fact.zh: 它是DOET的變體，在乙基鏈的末端接了一個氟原子。
fact.zhHans: 它是DOET的变体，在乙基链的末端接了一个氟原子。
